title: 足踏み式消毒液スタンド
description: 店舗や施設の入口に置く、足踏みペダル式の手指消毒液スタンドです。重りの台板と踏み板、引き棒、ステンレスの支柱、白いディスペンサーと残量窓、ノズル、受け皿、無地の案内板を造形しています。案内の文字や図記号、液体、ペダルと吐出の動作は含みません。 残量窓はGLB内の半透明（アルファブレンド）材質です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.320 × 1.190 × 0.330 m、1,020三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A foot-pedal hand sanitizer stand for shop and facility entrances. It models the weighted base plate and pedal, pull rod, stainless column, white dispenser with refill window, nozzle, drip tray and a blank instruction plate. Instruction text and symbols, liquid and pedal or dispensing motion are not included. The refill window uses an alpha-blended GLB material. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.320 × 1.190 × 0.330 m; 1,020 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
